goal: Add a read-only checker that verifies Supabase project/branch refs named in config sources against the account's real project and branch lists, reporting LIVE, RETIRED or UNKNOWN, with a positive control so a stale ref can never read as a deleted project.
dispatcher: Albert Hazan (session request to resolve issue #2429)
prohibited_actions: No database, preview, production, migration, claim, lease, or infrastructure write.
Never mutate any Supabase project or branch; only the projects list and branches list read commands may run.
Never read or print a secret.
assumptions: The checker runs on demand with the Supabase CLI already authenticated; CI runs its offline tests, not a live account listing, because CI holds no account token for this job.
The change requires no database object or migration-author route.
stop_conditions: Stop if the check would need a database credential or any write to Supabase.
Stop if completion requires any file outside the allowed paths.
